1.consolidated_definition: Manejar la Internet utilizando los recursos furl.net, que permite a los miembros almacenar resultados de investigaciones y compartirlas. Furl es la sigla por File Uniform Resource Locators. Neologismo anglicado, poco frecuente. En enero del 2005 invité a los visitantes de mi blog a comenzar a furlear la web utilizando Furl. Sin embargo, Furl se mantuvo demasiado estático y para finales del ese año ya estaba blinkeando (DigiZen, PR, 09-08-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To navigate the Internet using the resources provided by Furl.net, which allows members to store and share research results. Furl is an acronym for File Uniform Resource Locators, a relatively infrequent anglicized neologism. In January 2005, I invited visitors to my blog to begin "furling" the web using Furl. However, Furl remained too static, and by the end of that year it was already blinking (DigiZen, PR, 09-08-07).
